chapter: Quiz on tool use with Claude

questions.question: What is the correct sequence of the tool use workflow?
options: Initial request, tool request, data retrieval, final response
Final response, tool request, initial request, data retrieval
Data retrieval, initial request, final response, tool request
Tool request, final response, initial request, data retrieval

questions.topic: batch tool vs message batches api
questions.question: A quiz question asks what problem the "batch tool" solves. What's the important nuance here?
options: There's no literal "batch tool" in the tool-use material — the question actually refers to the separate Message Batches API for bulk async processing of independent requests
The batch tool is a built-in tool exactly like the text editor tool, with its own JSON schema
The batch tool automatically retries failed tool calls
The batch tool is only available in streaming mode

questions.question: What differentiates the built-in text editor and web search tools from each other?
options: Both provide a schema, but you may still need to implement functionality yourself — truer of the text editor than web search
The text editor tool requires no implementation at all, unlike web search
Web search requires a manual server-side implementation, unlike the text editor tool
Neither tool provides a schema; both must be built from scratch
